hints.title: Prefix Cumulative Bitwise Evaluation
hints.text: Subarray range bitwise exclusive or reduces to the difference between two prefix cumulative values.

hints.title: Binary Tree Prefix Search
hints.text: Store previous prefix values in a 31-bit binary trie with subtree occurrence counters.

hints.title: Bitwise Comparison Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the trie bit-by-bit from most significant to least significant, adding entire subtree counts when bits exceed k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: B: number of bits in representation (B <= 31)
complexity.notes: Prefix bitwise exclusive or tracking with binary trie prefix query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all N^2 subarray combinations exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary trie trades O(N * B) nodes for O(B) queries per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a binary trie to count prefix pairs whose XOR is at least k.
